name: lifecycle
description: The full ticket-to-green-branch lifecycle as callable skills: frame, grill, spec, plan, plan-check, build, plus tdd, diagnose, resolve-conflicts and show, and the six sub-agents they dispatch. Type /advance and it runs whichever phase comes next. Reads how your repo works — gates, tracker, forge, naming, review lenses, loop caps and the per-call effort budget — from eight files under .agents/, written by /onboard.
